name: classic-shards-live
_comment: The LIVE shards detach-verification scenario: the classic-shards choreography (engine_goldens/classic_trace/classic-shards.scenario.json) with NO SHARDS_* keys in the scenario config, so the ENTRY under verification drives its own click count / confirm window / assume-full — the scenario config would otherwise override the very knobs being verified. Both the native Classic run and the detached program replay the same world on the dust-free virtual clock, so a custom-timing entry that drifts off this choreography's happy path still produces byte-comparable (identical or honestly divergent) traces. Studio-tracked: this is a verification harness input, not a golden.
_screen_comment: Whole-box capacity paint (see classic-shards): keyframes are 0/1 only.
